My Aunt H is 91 years old.
If you saw her, you'd think she was in her 70s.
Very little wrinkles and great recollection of past events.

She and her husband stressed education above all.
I recall a statement made by him.
> They are all capable of fulfilling a cabinet level role, if asked.

Her 4 children are doing well and contributing to society, getting start through her seed money.
Her husband had died 11 years earlier from cancer.

However she seemed a bit tired of life. 
She felt her life had less meaning.

In passing she mentioned that in Switzerland where her 2nd daughter lives euthanasia is allowed.

I reminded her that the church that she attends, the Catholic church opposes euthanasia.

---

My mom had 3 sisters and a brother that escaped North Korea.
Because her father passed away each person suffered and needed to step up
This particular Aunt led the efforts in overcoming the economic hardship.
